The solution provided in the evidence is correct regarding the logic for validating a Sudoku board. To determine if a completed Sudoku board is valid, one must indeed verify that every row, every column, and every 3x3 sub-grid contains the digits 1 through 9 exactly once. The statement that the function returns true if the board is validly filled without repetitions accurately reflects the standard algorithmic approach to this problem.
